The Hand's tour (hand_prompts.gd, Dialogic 2): tour, each lesson's moment (on: landed, first_card, first_threat, court_waits, first_ruling, house_turns, winter), the seconds after it (after_sec) and its words, realm/data/tour/<timeline>.dtl (Dialogic timelines; [signal arg="spot:<part>"] rings a part of the screen: chronicle, card, armies, houses, pause, court, top, none). crowning._yield: seconds the line takes to give way when a card comes up (crowning.gd, ui.card_shown): one layer at a time
